Incident Receiver Resource Get Incident Receiver Servers
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/incidentReceiverServers

Gets a list of DLP Incident Receivers. To learn more, see About Zscaler Incident Receiver.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifier for the Incident Receiver.

name
string
REQUIRED

The Incident Receiver server name.

url
string
REQUIRED

The Incident Receiver server URL.

status
string
REQUIRED

The status of the Incident Receiver.

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED, DISABLED_BY_SERVICE_PROVIDER, NOT_PROVISIONED_IN_SERVICE_PROVIDER]

flags
int32

The Incident Receiver server flag.

]
